Fixes elements appearing after the top of the hour, ahead of the hour's liner.

When commercials land in a break, every element behind that break shifts later — so a song that sat comfortably inside its hour can end up starting after the top. Nothing re-checked the hour after the spots arrived, which is why you were seeing a sweeper and a song at 1:03 and 1:04 sitting in front of the 1:00 liner.

The hour is now re-checked whenever the commercial log is built, so anything pushed past the top is removed. It is safe to run at any time: a day that already lands on time is left untouched.

This was the piece your observation pinned down — that the adbreaks are the last thing to load during generation.
